TTOXTHEMES / COVERAGE AUDIT

Reference preview ≠ native kit delivery

Historical snapshot

Historical audit of the 17 November 2026 local scaffold. This inventory does not describe the current GitHub repository, which includes newer native generator and daemon code. See the repository root SPEC.md for the active native build contract.

17 November 2026 · audit of the supplied PRD, local native scaffold and current preview.

107unique FR/NFR requirements
0native end-to-end verified
35scaffold only
66missing

Also: 1 blocked input and 5 unverified performance/accessibility requirements. Scaffold is not a passing acceptance result.

The browser prototype demonstrates interaction ideas. Its sample metrics, local forms and shader tests do not satisfy Linux pack requirements. At the time of this historical local-scaffold audit, the installer was not ready and its generator and pack appliers were absent.

Scope changes and unresolved deviations

  • User extension: Add V-R-V3N0M as a fourth theme, inspired by the supplied liquid code; retain the system cursor.
  • User extension: Both KDE and XFCE are first-release targets; 2–4 GB/VM hardware is the primary design target.
  • User extension: Keyboard and mouse are equally supported; restrained glass with a dense layout and Android-style control center.
  • User extension: Independent concurrent tendrils preserve A hold while B seeks/holds; budgets are explicit, performance unverified.
  • User extension: Wi-Fi inspection/profile editing/passphrase flow is requested. Preview is demo-only; native system authorization must use polkit/secret-agent APIs.
  • Scope boundary: The user explicitly requested HTML as a reference. Browser work is not acceptance evidence for Linux packs.
  • Unresolved deviation: Native panels vs eww/Conky architecture has been proposed, not formally reconciled with the PRD renderer contract.
  • Unresolved deviation: Palette/token duplication, exact original geometry, full global hotkeys and blanket two-click action policy need reconciliation; do not silently drop requirements.

Recovery order

  1. P0: Freeze contracts; connect one palette/token source; implement generator and colour/contrast/determinism checks.
  2. P0: Complete exact dry-run plans, baseline snapshots and install→reinstall→rollback→uninstall tests before asking for a real install.
  3. P1: Build KDE and XFCE colour/window/terminal/panel/compositor appliers with capability/version gates and explicit per-pack tiers.
  4. P1: Implement ttoxd/schema/providers/user units, then real network/privileged actions and complete System/Network/Dev/Kali HUD coverage.
  5. P1: Complete widget folder contract, S/M/L, edit/gallery/grid persistence, four profiles and Conky fallback; restore every required hotkey and tmux drawer.
  6. P2: Finish wallpaper adaptation/guard, app/toolkit bridges, optional login/lock/boot, all seven .deb packages and container distro matrix.
  7. Acceptance: Run T1–T12, then A1–A12 on target desktops; report measured budgets and failed/degraded features without substituting browser simulations.
